fields.content: This assistant demonstrates **every setup-assistant field type**. The values you save here become the plugin's install config: scripts read them as `this.config.<key>`, and artifact configs can gate themselves with `"when": "Boolean({{config.<key>}})"` conditions. Description fields like this one support **markdown**.

fields.label: Enable Floating Frames
fields.tooltip: Reserved for the floating-frame surfaces of this plugin.

fields.label: Enable Data Adornments
fields.tooltip: Reserved for the data-adornment surfaces of this plugin.

fields.label: Enable Object Settings Item
fields.tooltip: Reserved for the object-settings surface of this plugin.

fields.label: Enable Context Dump Toolbar Item
fields.tooltip: Turn this off and the Context Dump toolbar item disappears — its config.json has a when-condition on this value.

fields.label: Enable Blocks
fields.tooltip: Turn this off to hide the Dashboard and Homepage blocks from their pickers — both have a when-condition on this value. The Chart Group and Record blocks omit when, so they stay available.

fields.content: The Context Dump toolbar item is now hidden. This note is itself a demo: descriptions support HTML too, and any field can carry a when condition over other fields' values.

fields.label: Context Value
fields.tooltip: A demo string scripts read back as this.config.contextValue. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes only (validation_pattern).

fields.label: Demo Number
fields.tooltip: An optional number input. Left blank, the key is simply absent from the saved config.

fields.label: Configure a Demo Object?
fields.tooltip: Unlocks the object and field pickers below — they need an object to pick fields from.

fields.label: Demo Object
fields.tooltip: A Kizen object picker. match_hint pre-selects an object whose api_name matches, when one exists.

fields.label: Demo Name Field
fields.tooltip: A single field picker, scoped to the demo object chosen above via object_id templating.

fields.content: These two selects fetch their options live through the `google_business` service proxy — authorize that service (the prerequisite step at the top of this assistant) before using them. The calendar select auto-picks when exactly one calendar comes back (`autoSelect`); the events select re-fetches whenever the calendar changes (`dependencies`).

fields.label: Calendar Events
fields.tooltip: Re-fetches when the calendar above changes. Falls back to the primary calendar when none is picked.
